principle: A mapped stance is a DECLARED reading of a coded answer — data, not code. Every reading below is disputable and versioned; changing a reading is a new spec version, never a silent edit. Codes the spec does not read map to no_reading (counted, visible, never given a stance they did not earn). The verbatim coded answer stays the operand; no opinion text is ever synthesized.

items.proposition: Demand-management measures (congestion charges or road-traffic limitation) are acceptable to reduce congestion.
items.rationale: Both instruments are demand-management; choosing either signals acceptance of the proposition. 'Definitely' answers are unambiguous; 'Probably' answers still declare a lean. 'No preferences' expresses no acceptance or rejection - it is not read.

items.proposition: Transport's environmental impacts are a serious concern.
items.rationale: A declared 1-10 self-rating: 8-10 reads as strong agreement, 1-3 as disagreement, the 4-7 middle band as neutral (a rating was given, but it does not commit either way). 'Don't know' is not read.

items.proposition: I would consider an electric or hybrid vehicle for my next purchase.
items.rationale: Certainly/Probably yes read as support, Certainly/Probably not as oppose; the explicit 'Maybe yes maybe not' is a genuinely two-sided answer (conditional). 'Don't know/no answer' is not read.
